usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), Eritrea
usdRate.note: 2025 average; the nakfa has been held at about 15 per US dollar for many years. The Bank of Eritrea website was not reachable for a 2026 rate.

inflation_cpi.note: No current consumer price inflation figure was found: the IMF World Economic Outlook series for Eritrea ends in 2019 (1.3%; imf.org datamapper API, read 2026-11), the World Bank has none, and the Bank of Eritrea and National Statistics Office websites were not reachable.

inflation_projection.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook (Eritrea CPI series ends in 2019 at 1.3%); nakfa fixed at about 15 per US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
inflation_projection.note: With no published CPI since 2019 and a nakfa held at 15 per dollar under tight import and currency controls, a cautious 5% (above dollar inflation, near the regional norm) is used for planning.

policy_rate.note: No published central bank policy rate was found; the Bank of Eritrea and National Statistics Office websites were not reachable.

savings_account_rate.note: No published savings account rate was found; the World Bank deposit rate series (FR.INR.DPST) has no Eritrea data and the Bank of Eritrea and National Statistics Office websites were not reachable.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month time deposit rate was found; the World Bank deposit rate series (FR.INR.DPST) has no Eritrea data and the Bank of Eritrea and National Statistics Office websites were not reachable.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year time deposit rate was found; the World Bank deposit rate series (FR.INR.DPST) has no Eritrea data and the Bank of Eritrea and National Statistics Office websites were not reachable.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No weighted average deposit rate was found; the World Bank deposit rate series (FR.INR.DPST) has no Eritrea data and the Bank of Eritrea and National Statistics Office websites were not reachable.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No treasury bill auctions or yields were found; government borrowing appears to be financed through the banking system without published yields.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No government bond market or yields were found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No government bond market or yields were found.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax rate on bank interest for individuals could not be confirmed; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries has no Eritrea page and no official tax source was reachable.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals exists, and no tax rule for such returns was found.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or cover limit was found.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card rate or legal cap was found; card lending is very limited.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No stock exchange in Eritrea; global equities in US dollar terms (nakfa fixed at about 15 per dollar, World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for global equities in dollar terms; foreign investing is also restricted by currency controls.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No stock exchange in Eritrea; global equities in US dollar terms (nakfa fixed at about 15 per dollar, World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
equity_return_base.note: No local stock market exists, so equity means a global index in dollar (nakfa) terms, kept about 3.5 points above an assumed after-tax safe saving rate of about 3%.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No stock exchange in Eritrea; global equities in US dollar terms (nakfa fixed at about 15 per dollar, World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF)
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities repeat their long-run dollar record.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Nakfa fixed at about 15 per US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF); dollar gold trend
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold prices under the fixed nakfa rate.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Nakfa fixed at about 15 per US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF); dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year, with no assumed devaluation of the fixed nakfa.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Nakfa fixed at about 15 per US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF); dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years or a devaluation of the nakfa.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: No published deposit or government security rates for Eritrea (World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no data); assumption
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary bank savings at low administered rates.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: No published deposit or government security rates for Eritrea (World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no data); assumption
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: bank savings and time deposits at modest administered rates; no rates are published, so a cautious 3% is used.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: No published deposit or government security rates for Eritrea (World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no data); assumption
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer time deposits at somewhat higher rates.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claim settlement ratio was found; no insurance regulator statistics were reachable.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Eritrea
oop_health_share.note: 48.4% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Planning inflation of 5% (no published Eritrea CPI after 2019, IMF WEO)
goal_inflation_health.note: No health price series is published; health goals use 1 point above the 5% planning inflation for imported medicines and private care.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Planning inflation of 5% (no published Eritrea CPI after 2019, IMF WEO)
goal_inflation_education.note: No education price series is published; education goals use 1 point above the 5% planning inflation, mainly for study abroad and private fees.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Eritrea
life_expectancy.note: 68.9 years in 2024 (men 66.8, women 70.9); latest available, older than 2025.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (the page gives a both-sexes figure only at 65).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.32 (2025, World Bank), 8.6 (2040, populationpyramid.net/eritrea/2040/) and 13.2 (2065, populationpyramid.net/eritrea/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The pension age for private-sector workers could not be confirmed; no official social security source was reachable and the ISSA and US SSA country profiles were blocked.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age of civil servants (public service pension proclamation) could not be confirmed from a readable official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: No published deposit rates for Eritrea; assumed safe saving rate about 3%

retirement_return_base.sourceName: No published deposit rates for Eritrea; assumed safe saving rate about 3%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: bank savings and time deposits at an assumed 3%, since no rates are published.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: No published deposit rates for Eritrea; assumed safe saving rate about 3%

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate about 3% (assumed); global equity base 6.5% in dollar terms; gold base 4%

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate about 3% (assumed); global equity base 6.5% in dollar terms; gold base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: mostly deposits with some gold; access to equity funds is very limited.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate about 3% (assumed); global equity base 6.5% in dollar terms; gold base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: more gold and foreign equity where permitted.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found from a reachable official source.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found from a reachable official source.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Proclamation's severance or end-of-service provisions could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: The rules of the public service pension scheme and whether any scheme covers private-sector workers could not be confirmed from a readable official source.

savings_account.note: Banks take savings deposits; rates are not published.

fdr_3m.note: Banks take time deposits, but rates are not published.

fdr_1y.note: Banks take time deposits, but rates are not published.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bill auctions open to individuals were found.

tbond_5y.note: No government bond market was found.

tbond_10y.note: No government bond market was found.

equity_fund.note: There is no stock exchange and no locally sold equity fund.

gold.note: Gold is bought mainly as jewellery; no official bullion or coin scheme was found.
